title.narrative: Programa de Equidad en la Educacin Bsica

description.narrative: The purpose of the program is to increase the coverage and quality of the basic cycle of education. Its objectives are: i) increase coverage of the second cycle of basic education, ii) improve multigrade schools pedagogy, iii) increase internal efficiency in marginal urban areas, iv) increase the school day, v) reform the teacher's pre-service training.
